what: The background art (glass ribbon·line drawing) is drawn out along a slanted edge — a 200° diagonal mask (48% visible · 52% hidden, height 300%) moves its position 50% 80% → 50% 0%, from when the section’s top edge reaches the screen center until its bottom edge reaches the center, with no curve, scrub 1

options.angle: Edge tilt (degrees), default 200 — the original’s second image uses 225
options.from · to: Vertical position (%) of the mask, default 80 · 0 — the 225° one uses from: 100
options.start · end: ScrollTrigger position, default top center · bottom center

from.where: index.html two .js-bg-line (About section glass ribbon 200° 80%→0 · recruitment info background ribbon 225° 100%→0 — original .js-home-bg-line). The site-wide set does the same job via index.js
